name: product-research
description: Buying-decision research methodology with deep prioritization on health and long-term safety for products that contact the body, food, skin, lungs, or sleep. Spawns parallel research teammates and synthesizes neutral surveys into an opinionated recommendation.

wikiRoot.title: Wiki root path
wikiRoot.description: Relative or absolute path to your Obsidian vault root (e.g. 'Wiki' or '~/Documents/MyVault'). Used to locate your vault's CLAUDE.md conventions doc when writing wiki notes.

resourcesBase.title: Resources folder
resourcesBase.description: Folder name for reference material at the vault root. Research surveys are saved under <resourcesBase>/Research/<topic>/. Vanilla PARA users can use 'Resources'.
